note: Adapted from the original English description by Ahmad 1965; both the alate and the soldier are described, and the measurements are taken respectively from Table 3 (10 alates) and Table 4 (holotype and 2 paratype soldiers), reproduced as given without conversion. Type localities Ka-Chong and Klang Dong, Thailand; holotype a soldier, morphotype an alate. In the OCR one instance of “premrasmii” appears as “premarasmii”, a typesetting word division; the scientific name is left unchanged.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate very similar to Coptotermes havilandi, differing in its larger size and darker colour; C. travians and C. heimi are smaller. In the soldier the opening of the frontal gland is broadly oval, 0.15 mm long and 0.12 mm wide, which distinguishes it from the remaining species of the genus.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head dark brown, with a crescent-shaped yellow band in front of each ocellus; postclypeus pale, anteclypeus white, labrum brownish yellow, mandibles dark reddish brown with paler bases, antennae pale brown, pronotum slightly darker than the head and with a T-shaped mark, wings pale smoky brown. Head sparsely covered with long hairs; short and long hairs scattered on the anterior and lateral margins and the disc of the pronotum. Head semicircular behind the compound eyes; the median arm of the Y suture distinct, the rest indistinct. Compound eyes moderately projecting; ocelli small, oval, almost touching the compound eyes. Anteclypeus trapezoidal. Labrum broad, rounded-domed, sides receding posteriorly. Posterior cutting margin of the first marginal tooth of the left mandible distinctly shorter than the anterior cutting margin of the second marginal tooth; posterior cutting margin of the second marginal tooth of the right mandible longer than the molar plate. Antennae 20—23-segmented, segment 3 shortest, segment 2 equal to or slightly longer than segment 4. Pronotum slightly wider than the head, more than 1.5 times as long as wide, anterior margin shallowly concave, lateral margins weakly convex, posterior margin depressed in the middle, anterolateral angles broadly rounded. Measurements (10 alates, holotype / range / mean): head length to the apex of the clypeus 1.55/1.40—1.55/1.50, head length to the lateral base of the mandibles 1.15/1.05—1.15/1.10, head width across the compound eyes 1.45/1.40—1.50/1.43, compound eye diameter 0.40/0.37—0.42/0.39, lower margin of the compound eye to the lower margin of the head 0.15, ocellus length 0.15/0.15—0.17/0.16, width 0.12/0.10—0.12/0.11, pronotum length 0.75/0.75—0.80/0.77, width 1.35/1.32—1.40/1.35 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head reddish yellow, labrum brownish yellow, mandibles dark reddish brown with paler bases, antennae pale brown, pronotum paler than the head, legs and abdominal tergites yellow. Head hairs very sparse; 2 long setae at the tip of the labrum, 2 setae on the anterior margin of the postmentum, a few short and long hairs only along the margins of the pronotum with the disc bare, and one row of setae on the posterior margin of each abdominal tergite. Head distinctly narrowed anteriorly, length equal to or slightly greater than width; opening of the frontal gland broadly oval, 0.15 mm long and 0.12 mm wide. Labrum longer than wide, transparent tip short. Mandibles slender and long, slightly curved apically; inner margin of the left mandible with 3 serrate projections at the base, the right mandible without them. Postmentum about 2 times as long as its maximum width, the anterior part 1.5 times as long as the posterior part, narrowest near the posterior margin. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 2 equal to or slightly longer than segment 3. Anterior margin of the pronotum slightly concave in the middle, lateral margins broadly convex, posterior margin depressed in the middle. Measurements (holotype / paratype): head length to the lateral base of the mandibles 1.45/1.40, head width at the lateral base of the mandibles 0.75/0.75, maximum head width 1.40/1.40, head height 0.95/0.90, left mandible length 0.90/0.90, postmentum length 0.87/0.85, postmentum maximum width 0.45/0.45, minimum width 0.27/0.30, pronotum length 0.50/0.50, width 0.95/0.95 mm.
